subject: General Studies
question: Who was the Governor-General of India during the establishment of the Students Literary and Scientific Society in 1848 A.D.?
explanation: The Marathi branch of the Students Literary and Scientific Society established in 1848 was named Paramhansa Sabha.

subject: General Studies
question: Name the Governor General whose description is given below: (a) He took interest in mass-education. (b) He wanted to establish Vernacular Schools. (c) He wanted to give education to the maximum people. (d) With his encouragement, the local governments in Bengal, Bombay and the Punjab gave encouragement to Vernacular education.
explanation: Lord Bentinck is known for his interest in mass education and the promotion of vernacular schools in India.

subject: General Studies
question: Against whom did Warren Hastings give military help to the Nawab of Oudh under the Subsidiary Alliance System?
explanation: Under the Subsidiary Alliance System, Warren Hastings provided military assistance to the Nawab of Oudh against the Rajputs.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs of the following newspapers and their founders or editors: (a) Jameendar (b) Al Hilal (c) Comred (d) Independent
explanation: Jameendar was founded by Maulana Azad, Al Hilal by Maulana Azad, Comred by Jafar Ali Khan, and Independent by Mohammad Ali.

subject: General Studies
question: In 1875 the farmers in the two district in Maharashtra insurrectionise against a pawn-broker, landholder and the British Officer?
explanation: The 1875 farmers uprising in Maharashtra took place in Pune and Ahmednagar districts.

subject: General Studies
question: Which sects in Maharashtra brought knowledge in Sanskrit language to Marathi language? (a) Varkari sect (b) Nath sect (c) Mahanubhav sect (d) Datta sect
explanation: The Varkari and Nath sects were instrumental in bringing Sanskrit knowledge to the Marathi language.

subject: General Studies
question: In September 1816, who got the sanction to supress the Pindharias from the Court of Directors?
explanation: Lord Hastings received sanction to suppress the Pindaris from the Court of Directors in September 1816.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the following: (a) Natya Niketan (b) Natya Manwantar (c) Ashirwad (d) Lalitkaladarsha
explanation: Natya Niketan was founded by Motiram Gajanan Rangnekar, Natya Manwantar by young idealists devoted to Ibsen and Shaw, Ashirwad by Keshavrao Bhosle and Bapurao Pendharkar, and Lalitkaladarsha by Jyotsna Bhole and Vishnupant Aundhkar.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs of the historical literature with its authors: (a) Thorle Madhavrao Peshwe (b) Raja Shivaji (c) Mochangad (d) Afzalkhanachya Mrutyuche Natak
explanation: Thorle Madhavrao Peshwe was written by V.J. Keertane, Raja Shivaji by M.M. Kunte, Mochangad by R.B. Gunjikar, and Afzalkhanachya Mrutyuche Natak by Kondo Sakharam Ghate.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the following companies and the places where they are located: (a) Jessop and Company (b) Mackay and Company (c) Bengal Iron Company (d) Alexander and Company
explanation: Jessop and Company is in Ranigunj, Mackay and Company in Barakar, Bengal Iron Company in Asansol, and Alexander and Company in Calcutta.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the following: (a) Krishnashastri Chiplunkar (b) Morbhat Dandekar (c) Gangadharshastri Phadke (d) Vishnu Bhikaji Gokhale
explanation: Krishnashastri Chiplunkar argued with Reverend Dr. John Wilson on Hinduism, Morbhat Dandekar wrote Vicharlahari, Gangadharshri Phadke wrote Samudrakinaricha Vadvivad, and Vishnu Bhikaji Gokhale wrote Hindudharma Tatva.

subject: General Studies
question: The annual convention of the All India Hindu Mahasabha was held on 19th August 1923 at ______ under the presidency of Madan Mohan Malviya.
explanation: The annual convention of the All India Hindu Mahasabha was held in Kashi (Varanasi) in 1923.

subject: General Studies
question: Consider the following statements about Mahatma Gandhi and untouchability Eradication: (a) Problem of untouchability Eradication was not important than swaraj according to him. (b) He founded Akhil Bhartiya Harijan Sevak Sangh. (c) He had not encouraged marriages between Savarna and Harijan. Which of the above statements are not correct?
explanation: Gandhi considered untouchability eradication as important as Swaraj, so (a) is incorrect. He encouraged inter-caste marriages, so (c) is incorrect.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following statement(s) is/are wrong? (a) Lokmanya Tilak and G.G. Agarkar founded New English School in Pune. (b) Agarkar wrote first in the newspaper Vijayi Maratha and later in Sudharak. (c) Sudharak weekly was published in both Marathi and English languages.
explanation: Sudharak was a Marathi weekly, not bilingual. So statement (c) is wrong.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the following: (a) Damodar Valley (b) Hirakud (c) Nagarjun Sagar (d) Bhakara-Nangal
explanation: Damodar Valley is in Bihar and West Bengal, Hirakud in Orissa, Nagarjun Sagar in Andhra Pradesh, and Bhakara-Nangal in Punjab.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs: (a) Kheda Satyagraha (b) Establishment of Sabarmati Ashram (c) Champaranya Satyagraha (d) First fast for mill workers
explanation: Kheda Satyagraha (1918), Sabarmati Ashram (1917), Champaran Satyagraha (1917), First fast for mill workers (1918).

subject: General Studies
question: Who organised A Conference of Untouchables at Mangaon in 1920?
explanation: Maharshi Vitthal Ramji Shinde organized the Conference of Untouchables at Mangaon in 1920.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs: (a) Union Boarding House (b) Chhatrapati Shahu Boarding House (c) Chhatrapati Shivaji College (d) Sant Gadage Maharaj College
explanation: Union Boarding House (1924), Chhatrapati Shahu Boarding House (1947), Chhatrapati Shivaji College (1954), Sant Gadage Maharaj College (1932).

subject: General Studies
question: Nighoj, a famous place for potholes is in ______ taluka of Maharashtra.
explanation: Nighoj, known for its potholes, is located in Parner taluka of Ahmednagar district, Maharashtra.

subject: General Studies
question: By which of the following reason the lowland area of Konkan is formed?

options.A: Due to upliftment of the Arabian Sea cost
options.B: Due to the subsidence of western part of Maharashtra Plateau
options.C: Due to the creation of Sahyadri Mountain
options.D: Due to the erosional work of Sea waves

explanation: The lowland area of Konkan was formed due to the subsidence of the western part of the Maharashtra Plateau.

subject: General Studies
question: In which of the following Mumbai Suburbs Bauxite deposits occur?
explanation: Bauxite deposits occur in Vikhroli, Chembur, and Anushaktinagar in Mumbai suburbs.

subject: General Studies
question: Which river is a tributary of Ganga river and originates near Amarkantak?
explanation: The Son River is a tributary of the Ganga and originates near Amarkantak.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following pair of Tourist places in Buldhana district is not true?
explanation: Lonar is known for its crater lake, not a Demon Sudans temple. Jamod is known for an ancient Jain temple, not a fort. So (a) and (d) are incorrect.

subject: General Studies
question: Ellen Semple, Humboldt, Ritter, Ratzel are supporter of ______. (a) Possibilism (b) Determinism (c) Stop and Go Determinism
explanation: Ellen Semple, Humboldt, Ritter, and Ratzel are supporters of Determinism.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following mineral is used in Production of High Quality Steel?
explanation: Manganese is used in the production of high-quality steel.

subject: General Studies
question: Dharmvirgad is in ______ village of Maharashtra.
explanation: Dharmvirgad is located in Pedgaon village of Maharashtra.

subject: General Studies
question: Who is the writer of a book, Influences of Geographical Environment written in 1911?
explanation: Ellen Churchill Semple wrote Influences of Geographical Environment in 1911.

subject: General Studies
question: Tarun, Ujwal, Sagar and Mayur are the varieties of ______ in Maharashtra.
explanation: Tarun, Ujwal, Sagar, and Mayur are varieties of Brinjal in Maharashtra.

subject: General Studies
question: Core Part of the Earth is mainly made up of ______ and ______ minerals.
explanation: The Earths core is mainly composed of Nickel and Iron (NiFe).

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following statements about Arun Bongirwar Public Service Excellence Award is not true?

options.A: This award is constituted in the memory of 25th Chief Secretary of Maharashtra; Mr. Arun Bongirwar.
options.B: This is to recognise outstanding work of two civil servants from Maharashtra annually.
options.C: For the first time in 2018 it is given to Shri. Ankush Shinde (IPS) for peaceful and inclusive resolution of Naxlite issues in Gadchiroli District.
options.D: It is a initiative of Arun Bongirwar Foundation and YASHADA.

explanation: The award was first given in 2018 to Shri. Ankush Shinde for his work in Gadchiroli. The other statements are correct.
